table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode,  
	itemname= item.name, 
	locksaleprice = dbo.item.locksaleprice,
	lockdiscperc = dbo.item.lockdiscperc,
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock     = 0.0000, 
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	purprice=max(saledetail.purunitrate),
	rppunitrate=max(saledetail.rppunitrate),
	avgprice=max(saledetail.avgprice),
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	qtysale=item.saleqty,
	bonus=item.bonusqty,
	assgcode  = 1, 
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	saledetail.saleinvcode,   
	saledetail.icode,   
	saledetail.gcode,
	Itemflatdisc = max(case when Saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc > 0 THEN Saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc ELSE Saledetail.itemflatdisc END),
	Id        = max(saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits),
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice),
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),  
	Due       = max(Due),
	SatisfiedDate = max(SatisfiedDate),
	DueQty    = 0,
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty),
	TaxType = (SELECT MAX(STS.TaxType) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	SaleItemDescription =  max( saledetail.SaleItemDescription),
	claimable= max(saledetail.claimable),
	claimablediscperc= max(saledetail.claimablediscperc),
	discperc  = max(case when saledetail.clonediscperc > 0 THEN saledetail.clonediscperc ELSE saledetail.discperc END),
	itemcode = 0,
	retailprice=item.retailprice,
	packprice = max(saledetail.packprice),
	unitsalestax=max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc=max(saledetail.gstperc),
	packqtyforsale = Max(saledetail.packqtyforsale) ,
	bonuspackqtyforsale = Max(saledetail.bonuspackqtyforsale),
	bonusqty  = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty),
	invdiscperc= ISNULL( (select dbo.saleledger.discperc from dbo.saleledger where dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode), 0),
	viewsaleinvmarginpreviewon = (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('viewsaleinvmarginpreview'))
FROM 
	saledetail, item
WHERE 
	( dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )    AND
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saledetail.saleinvcode, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.customicode, 
	item.saleqty,
	item.bonusqty,
	item.name,
	item.locksaleprice,
	item.lockdiscperc,
	item.retailprice,
	Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode
ORDER BY 
	MIN(saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum(((  looseqty *  saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   discperc  * .01 )  ) ) - (looseqty*avgprice) for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: (sum(c1 for all) - sum(c2 for all) -  sum((looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax for all)) * 100 / if(sum(c1 for all)=0, 1, sum(c1 for all))

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: sum(c1 - c2 - ((looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax) for all)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: sum(Round(( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) ) * ( 1 - ( discperc * .01 ) ), 2) *( 1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: sum((looseqty + bonusqty) * if( viewsaleinvmarginpreviewon = '6', avgprice, rppunitrate) for all)

objects.name: c4
objects.expression: ( c1 - c2 - ((looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax)) * 100/ if(c1=0,1, c1)

objects.name: c1
objects.expression: Round(( looseqty * (if(taxtype='D' or taxtype='E', rate, saleprice) - itemflatdisc) ) * ( 1 - ( discperc * .01 ) ), 2) *( 1 - invdiscperc * 0.01)
